project_audit_note: Project audit masks top42% of silhouette, which on a quadruped mostly covers articulated wings instead of torso/head. Its drift flags and not-measured rows are retained verbatim, not waived as passes. Independent torso audit excludes those structures and requires posterior coverage. A proxy fit does not certify skeleton length.
open_acceptance: 20 non-seed frames have insufficient torso feature coverage. Cannot certify +/-4% torso length for all44. Review against seed, revise whole strips if needed, do not rescale individual frames.
